{{Quote|I can only live so much of a lie.|Hallena Devis|<ref name="The Clone Wars: No Prisoners">''[[The Clone Wars: No Prisoners]]''</ref>}}
'''Hallena Devis''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] for [[Republic Intelligence/Legends|Republic Intelligence]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and was the lover of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]].

==Biography==
Hallena joined the intelligence service of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] sometime prior to the Clone Wars. She was sent to [[JanFathal]] during the conflict to help the government there against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]-backed revolutionaries. She was captured and held by Separatist followers on after they learned that she was a Republic spy, but Gilad Pellaeon and several [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] came to extract her.

After the [[Battle of JanFathal]], she unofficially stopped working with the Republic, and journeyed with unorthodox [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Djinn Altis/Legends|Djinn Altis]] and his followers. Later she reconnected with Pellaeon, giving birth to a son, [[Mynar Devis|Mynar]], by him. Hallena officially left Republic Intelligence to try to get her life in order, after becoming disillusioned with the Republic government.

==Personality and traits==
Hallena was a caring person, feeling guilty when [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] [[Ince]] and [[Vere]] were killed in her rescue. She became disillusioned with the Republic after the happenings on JanFathal, where she had to support an oppressive regime and found the Separatist revolutionaries to be likable. It resulted in her leaving the Republic's service.
